messages.en: Is that new player any good?
He's no ordinary player, you know. He's already played for his state!

senses.en_definition: One half of something; one of a pair; one of two sides.
A side, part, or direction; a particular part of the day.
Beside or next to someone or something.
A general term for various marine flatfish, usually in the phrase ikan sebelah.

messages.en: I'm outside the bank now. Where's that restaurant you mentioned?
It's right next to the bank, the one with the green sign. I'm sitting outside.
Oh, I see it! Hang on, I'm walking over.

senses.en_definition: Before an action or event occurs; while something has not yet happened.
Earlier than a specified time or event.

messages.en: Text me before you get here, okay? I'll come downstairs and wait for you.
Okay, I'll be there in ten minutes. I'll text you when I'm close.
We're leaving on Saturday morning, right?
Yeah, just pack your bag the night before. We can head straight off that morning.
